title: Local noninteracting ensemble representation of Coulomb ground densities
exact_target: Must every normalizable full Coulomb electronic ground-state density be the density of some ground-state ensemble of a local noninteracting Kohn–Sham Hamiltonian with potential in the admissible source class V? It suffices to test three electrons with two identical finite-charge nuclei and the fixed spin sector $S_z=1/2$.
